title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
english: Iran's recent missile attack on a US base suggests a strategic shift toward limited confrontation rather than total war or peace. Both nations are avoiding a full-scale conflict to prevent economic collapse and regional instability. By keeping the situation volatile, Iran aims to maintain leverage over global energy markets and shipping routes while resisting ongoing sanctions.
amharic: ኢራን በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ ጣቢያ ላይ ያደረሰችው የሮኬት ጥቃት፣ አገሪቱ ከሁለንተናዊ ጦርነት ወይም ከሰላም ይልቅ ቁጥጥር የሚደረግበት ውሱን ግጭትን እንደምትመርጥ ያሳያል። ሁለቱም አገራት ከባድ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ቀውስን እና ቀጣናዊ አለመረጋጋትን ለመከላከል ሲሉ ወደ ሙሉ ጦርነት ከመግባት ይቆጠባሉ። ኢራን ይህን ውጥረት በመጠቀም በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ እና በባህር ትራንስፖርት ላይ ተጽዕኖዋን ለማስቀጠል እና ማዕቀቦችን ለመቋቋም እየሞከረች ነው።
oromo: Iraan dhiheenya kana buufata waraana Ameerikaa irratti haleellaa rookeettii raawwachuun ishee, biyyattiin waraana guutuu ykn nagaa buusuu mannaa, walitti bu'iinsa daangeeffame akka filattu kan agarsiisuudha. Biyyoonni lamaanuu kisaaraa dinagdee guddaa fi tasgabbii dhabuu naannawaa sanaa ittisuuf jecha waraana guutuu irraa of qusachaa jiru. Iraan walitti bu'iinsa kana fayyadamtee gabaa annisaa fi daandiiwwan geejjiba galaanaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuun, akkasumas kaffaltii diinagdee ishee irratti jiru mormuuf karoorfachaa jirti.

title: Hundreds of migrants swim from Morocco to Spanish enclave of Ceuta
english: In the past week, a large number of migrants have entered the Spanish enclave of Ceuta by swimming from Morocco or crossing border fences. Local officials report that this surge has overwhelmed regional facilities and created a humanitarian emergency. The Spanish government is planning to visit the territory to address the security situation and the strain on resources for minors.
amharic: ባለፈው ሳምንት በርካታ ቁጥር ያላቸው ስደተኞች ከሞሮኮ በመዋኘት ወይም የድንበር አጥርን በመሻገር ወደ ስፔን ግዛት ሱዌታ ገብተዋል። የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት ይህ የሰው ኃይል መጨመር የአካባቢውን የመቀበያ ማዕከላት አቅም እንደገደበውና የሰብአዊ ቀውስ እንደፈጠረ ገልጸዋል። የስፔን መንግስት የጸጥታ ሁኔታውን ለመገምገም እና ለችግሩ መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ በቅርቡ ወደ አካባቢው እንደሚጓዝ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Torban darbe keessa baay'inni godaantotaa Morokoo irraa gara daangaa Ispeen, Si'uutaa (Ceuta) jedhamutti daakuudhaan ykn daangaa qaxxaamuruudhaan galaniiru. Qondaalonni naannichaa akka jedhanitti, namoonni baay'inaan seenuun kun bakka qubataafi tajaajila adda addaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuun rakkoo namoomaa guddaa fideera. Mootummaan Ispeen haala nageenyaafi rakkoo mudate kana ilaalchisee tarkaanfii fudhachuuf gara naannichaa deemuf karoorfateera.

title: Rights report reconstructs fatal shooting of Palestinian man
english: A human rights organization called Al-Haq has released a detailed investigation into the killing of Awdeh al-Hathaleen, a Palestinian man shot one year ago. Using video evidence, forensics, and spatial mapping, the report identifies an Israeli settler named Yinon Levy as the person responsible for the shooting. The findings emphasize that the victim was unarmed and did not present any danger at the time of his death.
amharic: አል-ሀቅ የተባለ የሰብአዊ መብት ተቋም ከአንድ አመት በፊት ስለተገደለው ፍልስጤማዊው አውዴህ አል-ሃታሌን ግድያ ዝርዝር መረጃ አውጥቷል። የቪዲዮ ማስረጃዎችን፣ የፎረንሲክ ምርመራዎችን እና የቦታ መረጃዎችን በመጠቀም፣ ሪፖርቱ ግድያውን የፈጸመው ይኖን ሌቪ የተባለ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪ መሆኑን አመልክቷል። ግለሰቡ ሲገደል ምንም አይነት መሳሪያ ያልታጠቀ እና ምንም አይነት አደጋ የማይፈጥር እንደነበር ምርመራው አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa Al-Haq jedhamu, waggaa tokko dura ajjeechaa namicha Falasxiinii Awdeh al-Hathaleen jedhamuu irratti qorannoo bal’aa geggeesseera. Ragaalee viidiyoo, qorannoo saayinsii fi kaartaa fayyadamuun, gabaasichi ajjeechaa kana kan raawwate Yinoon Levii jedhamu kan ta’e qubata Israa’el akka ta’e beeksiseera. Qorannoon kun akka ibsutti, namichi ajjeefame sun meeshaa tokko illee kan hin qabneefi yeroo ajjeefamu miidhaa tokko illee kan hin geessifne ture.

title: ‘To play God’: Cuba’s healthcare system collapses under US pressure
english: Cuba’s healthcare system is facing a severe crisis as intensified United States sanctions and a fuel blockade have led to critical shortages of medical supplies and electricity. Doctors report a heartbreaking rise in mortality rates, particularly among newborns, due to poor hygiene and a lack of essential medications. The political tension between the two nations is severely undermining the country's public health services, which were once a source of national pride.
amharic: የኩባ የጤና አጠባበቅ ሥርዓት በአሜሪካ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እና በነዳጅ እገዳ ምክንያት ከባድ ቀውስ ውስጥ ገብቷል። የህክምና ቁሳቁሶች እጥረት እና የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ ለብዙ ህሙማን በተለይም ለአራስ ህጻናት ሞት መነሻ ሆኗል። የሁለቱ አገራት የፖለቲካ አለመግባባት ለረጅም ጊዜ የኩባ መመኪያ የነበረውን የነፃ የጤና አገልግሎት አቅም በእጅጉ ጎድቶታል።
oromo: Sirni fayyaa biyya Kuubaa sababa qoqqobbii diinagdee Ameerikaa fi dhorkaa boba'aatiin rakkoo cimaa keessa galee jira. Hanqinni meeshaalee yaalaa fi hanqinni humna ibsaa sababa ta'ee, duuti namootaa keessattuu kan daa'immanii dabalaa jira. Wal dhabdeen siyaasaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru, tajaajilli fayyaa tolaa biyyattiin ittiin beekamtu akka laafu taasisee jira.

title: In Their Own Hands: Ghana’s Drug Vigilantes
english: In Ghana, an escalating crisis involving synthetic opioid addiction has led local residents in Tamale to form volunteer task forces. These groups are patrolling streets and punishing drug dealers and users directly because they believe the government has failed to act. While some officials support these efforts, critics argue that such vigilante justice poses significant risks and cannot replace official law enforcement.
amharic: በጋና እየተባባሰ የመጣው ሰው ሰራሽ አደንዛዥ ዕፅ ሱሰኝነት በታማሌ ከተማ ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ተቃውሞ በማስነሳቱ በራሳቸው የተደራጁ የፀጥታ ቡድኖች እንዲቋቋሙ አድርጓል። እነዚህ ቡድኖች መንግስት ችግሩን ለመቅረፍ በቂ እርምጃ እየወሰደ አይደለም በሚል እሳቤ፣ የራሳቸውን ህግ በመተግበር አዘዋዋሪዎችን እና ሱሰኞችን እየቀጡ ይገኛሉ። አንዳንዶች ይህንን ተግባር የሚደግፉ ቢሆንም፣ ባለሙያዎች ግን የህግ የበላይነትን በግለሰቦች እጅ መጣሉ አደገኛ እንደሆነ ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Gaanaa keessatti babal'achuu qoricha sammuu hadoochuun walqabatee, jiraattonni magaalaa Taamaalee tarkaanfii mataa isaanii fudhachuuf garee fedhii irratti hundaaye ijaarataniiru. Gareen kun mootummaan rakkoo kana furuuf gahaa miti jedhanii waan amannaniif, gurguddootaa fi fayyadamtoota qorichichaa irratti ofumaan seera kabachiisuuf yaalii gochaa jiru. Mootummaan qaama tokko tokko garee kana deeggaraa kan jiru yoo tahu, gareen biraa garuu seera of harka galchuun kun balaa guddaa akka qabu fi bakka seera mootummaa hin bu'u jedhanii akeekkachiisu.

title: NATO jets scramble as Russian missile detonates in Poland
english: A Russian missile launched during an attack on Ukraine strayed into Polish territory and exploded, prompting NATO to deploy fighter jets for defense. While the incident caused no casualties in Poland, it has increased regional fears that the ongoing war could spill over into neighboring countries. Both Polish and NATO officials have condemned the event as a dangerous and reckless provocation by Russia.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ላይ የከፈተችው የጥቃት አካል የሆነ የሚሳይል ጥቃት የፖላንድን ድንበር ጥሶ በመግባቱ የኔቶ አየር ኃይል ተዋጊ ጄቶችን አሰማርቷል። በፖላንድ በኩል ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ባያጋጥምም፣ ክስተቱ ጦርነቱ ወደ ጎረቤት አገራት ሊዛመት ይችላል የሚለውን ስጋት ከፍ አድርጎታል። የፖላንድ እና የኔቶ ባለስልጣናት ይህንን የሩሲያ ድርጊት አደገኛ እና ሀላፊነት የጎደለው ድርጊት ሲሉ አውግዘውታል።
oromo: Rusiyan haleellaa Yukreen irratti raawwatte keessaa misayiliin tokko daangaa Poolaand ce'ee kufuun isaa, mootummaan Poolaand fi NATO xiyyara waraanaa akka sochoosan dirqisiiseera. Poolaand keessatti namni miidhame hin jiruus, gochi kun waraanni kun gara biyyoota ollaa akka babal'achuu danda'u sodaa guddaa uumeera. Hogganoonni Poolaand fi NATO tarkaanfii Rusiyaan fudhatte kana gocha balaa fi of-eeggannoo hin qabne jechuun balaaleeffataniiru.

title: IRGC video of retaliatory strikes on US targets in Jordan
english: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps has shared footage purportedly showing missile strikes against American aircraft at an air base in Jordan. Iran claims this military action was a response to previous US attacks on Qeshm Island that resulted in three fatalities. This incident highlights rising tensions between the two nations following the deadly strikes.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይል በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኘው የአል አዝራቅ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ አውሮፕላኖች ላይ ሚሳኤል ማውረዱን የሚያሳይ ምስል ይፋ አድርጓል። ኢራን ይህ እርምጃ በቃሽም ደሴት ላይ ሶስት ሰዎችን የገደለው የአሜሪካ ጥቃት አጸፋ መሆኑን ገልጻለች። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ይበልጥ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Humnoonni Eegumsa Kutaawwan Kilaa'ulaa (IRGC) kan Iiraan, buufata xiyyaaraa Yordaanos keessatti argamu Al-Azraaq irratti xiyyaara Ameerikaa garaa xiyyaaraan haleeluu isaanii agarsiisuu ragaa viidiyoo gadi lakkisaniiru. Iiraan haleellaan kun, Ameerikaan odola Qeshm irratti weerara raawwattee namoota sadii ajjeesteef haaloo ba'uuf kan raawwatame ta'uu ibsiteetti. Taateen kun walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru kan dhiphiseedha.

title: US GDP growth dips as inflation and trade deficits pressure economy
english: The U.S. economy experienced a slowdown in the second quarter of 2026, with GDP growth dropping to 1.5 percent from 2.1 percent earlier in the year. This decline is largely attributed to a widening trade deficit and rising fuel costs, which continue to strain consumer finances. While technology investments and consumer spending provided some support, persistent inflation remains a significant challenge for the national economy.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ በ2026 ሁለተኛ ሩብ ዓመት ላይ የዕድገት መቀዛቀዝ አሳይቷል፣ ይህም ከዓመቱ መጀመሪያ የነበረውን 2.1 በመቶ ወደ 1.5 በመቶ ዝቅ አድርጎታል። ይህ መቀነስ በዋናነት የተከሰተው የንግድ ልውውጥ ጉድለት በመስፋፋቱ እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ በመጨመሩ ምክንያት የሸማቾችን ጫና በመጨመሩ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የቴክኖሎጂ ኢንቨስትመንቶች እና የሸማቾች ወጪ የተወሰነ ድጋፍ ቢሰጡም፣ ግሽበት በሀገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ትልቅ ፈተና ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Dinagdeen Yunaayitid Isteetes waggaa 2026 keessatti, ji'oota darbanii keessa guddina gadi bu'aa galmeessiseera; kunis guddina kanaan dura ture kan %2.1 ture gara %1.5 tti gad buuseera. Gadi bu'iinsi kun kan dhufe hanqina daldalaa guddachuu fi gatiin boba'aa dabaluun baasii ummataa irratti dhiibbaa waan uumeefid. Invastimantiin teknolojiin fi baasiin gurgurtaa guddina dinagdeetiif deeggarsa ta'us, gatiin meeshaalee fi tajaajilaa dabaluun (inflation) rakkoo guddaa dinagdee biyyattii ta'ee itti fufeera.

title: Iran’s foreign minister presses European counterparts over bases used in US operations
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has warned Bulgaria and Cyprus against allowing their territories to host US military aircraft for operations against Iran. He argued that providing such support facilitates aggression and damages diplomatic ties. Tehran has further cautioned that nations permitting the use of their bases for American military actions may encounter negative repercussions.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ቡልጋሪያ እና ሳይፕረስ የአሜሪካ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በግዛታቸው እንዲሰፍሩ መፍቀዳቸው ስህተት መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል። እንዲህ ዓይነቱ ድጋፍ በኢራን ላይ የሚፈጸም ጥቃት አካል መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ ሀገራቱ ለዚህ ተግባር መሰረተ ልማታቸውን ካመቻቹ የሚያስከትለው መዘዝ እንደሚኖር ገልጸዋል። አራግቺ ይህ አካሄድ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ወዳጅነት የሚጎዳ መሆኑንም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbas Araagchiin, biyyoonni Bulgaariyaa fi Saayippires xiyyaara waraanaa Ameerikaa buufata isaanii akka fayyadamaniif heyyamuu isaanii akka balaaleffatan ibsan. Iraan akka jetteetti, biyyoonni buufata isaanii Ameerikaaf yoo kennan, kun weerara Iraan irratti gaggeeffamu akka deggaruutti fudhatama. Kanaafuu, biyyoonni kun gocha kana irraa of qusachuu akka qaban, yoo ta’uu baate garuu tarkaanfii irraa fudhatamuufi akka qabu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Chaos at London court as over 1,500 Palestine Action cases listed in one day
english: London's legal system faced significant disruption as over 1,500 individuals linked to Palestine Action protests were incorrectly summoned to Westminster Crown Court. Despite previous notifications that their hearings had been delayed until October, court records listed these cases for a single day, leading to widespread confusion and contradictory instructions for defendants. Critics describe this administrative breakdown as evidence of a struggling judicial system as the Supreme Court simultaneously reviews the legality of the government's ban on the activist group.
amharic: ከፓለስታይን አክሽን ተቃውሞ ጋር በተያያዘ ከ1,500 በላይ ሰዎች የሽብር ክስ የቀረበባቸው ሲሆን፣ በለንደን ፍርድ ቤት በተፈጠረ የቢሮክራሲ ስህተት ከፍተኛ ውዥንብር ተፈጥሯል። ቀደም ሲል ቀጠሮአቸው ወደ ጥቅምት ወር መተላለፉ ተነግሮአቸው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በስህተት ሁሉም በአንድ ቀን እንዲቀርቡ በመደረጉ ተከሳሾች ግራ ተጋብተዋል። ይህ ክስተት በፍትህ ስርዓቱ ላይ ከፍተኛ መዘበራረቅ መፈጠሩን ያሳየ ሲሆን፣ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤቱም ቡድኑ ላይ የተጣለውን እገዳ ህጋዊነት እየመረመረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Namoonni 1,500 ol ta'an kanneen duula Palestine Action waliin walqabatee himannaan shororkummaa irratti baname, manni murtii Landan keessatti wal-dhaba guddaa uumaniiru. Qabxiiwwan himannaa isaanii gara ji'a Onkololeessaatti dabarfamee osoo jiruu, dogoggora bulchiinsaatiin hundi isaanii guyyaa tokkotti akka dhiyaatan waamamuun isaanii namoota hedduu burjaajesseera. Rakkoon kun sirni haqaa biyyattii keessatti quubsa kan hin qabne ta'uu kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, manni murtii olaanoon immoo dhorkaa garee kana irratti fudhatamee ture irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jira.

title: US military says no aircraft hit in attempted Iranian attacks
english: The United States military has officially denied claims made by Iran's Revolutionary Guard regarding the destruction of several American fighter jets. Officials stated that none of their aircraft sustained damage or were lost during recent hostile activities. Furthermore, the U.S. Central Command dismissed reports that a commercial ship had successfully bypassed their blockade of Iranian ports.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል የኢራን አብዮታዊ ዘብ በበርካታ የአሜሪካ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰናል በሚል ያቀረበውን ውንጀላ አስተባብሏል። ምንም ዓይነት የአሜሪካ አውሮፕላን በቅርቡ በተፈጠሩ ግጭቶች እንዳልወደመ ወይም እንዳልተጎዳ አስታውቋል። በተጨማሪም የአሜሪካ ሴንትራል ኮማንድ አንድ የንግድ መርከብ በአሜሪካ የታገዱ የኢራን ወደቦችን ጥሶ ገብቷል የሚለውን ዘገባ ውድቅ አድርጓል።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa himata gareen 'Revolutionary Guard' kan Iraan xiyyaarota waraana Ameerikaa miidheera jechuun dhiyeesse guutummaatti haaleera. Humni waraana Ameerikaa akka ibsetti, haleellaa dhiyeenya kana mudateen xiyyaarotni isaanii tokkollee hin miidhamne ykn hin barbadoofne. Kana malees, qondaaltotni waraana Ameerikaa markabni daldalaa tokko daangaa Ameerikaan buufatawwan Iraan irratti kaa'e cabsee darbeera kan jedhu gabaasichi soba ta'uu beeksisaniiru.

title: Supreme Court will allow appeal hearing over Palestine Action ban
english: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear an appeal from Palestine Action's co-founder regarding the government's decision to label the organization a terrorist group. While a previous court ruling supported the ban as a necessary step for national security, Huda Ammori continues to fight this classification. This upcoming hearing will determine if the restriction on the group's activities remains legally justified.
amharic: የፓለስቲን አክሽን መስራች የቡድኑን በአሸባሪነት የመፈረጅ ውሳኔ በመቃወም ለጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ይግባኝ አቅርበዋል። መንግስት በሀገር ደህንነት ስም የወሰደውን ይህን እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ ፍርድ ቤቶች ተቀብለውት የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ መስራቿ ሁዳ አሞሪ ክርክሯን ቀጥላለች። አሁን ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤቱ ጉዳዩን ለመስማት በመስማማቱ፣ የእግዱ ህጋዊነት በድጋሚ ይታያል።
oromo: Hundeeessaan garee 'Palestine Action' mootummaan garee isaanii akka garee shororkeessitti ramaduu isaatti mormii dhiyeessuun gara mana murtii olaanaatti ol iyyannoo galfateera. Mootummaan nageenya biyyaa eeguuf jecha dhorkaa kana kaa'e yoo ta'u, mana murtiiwwan duraan turanis murtii kana deggeranii turan. Amma mana murtii olaanaatti dhimmi kun irra deebi'amee akka ilaalamuuf murtaa'eera.

title: Supreme Court will allow appeal hearing over Palestine Action ban
english: The UK Supreme Court has agreed to hear an appeal from Huda Ammori, the co-founder of the group Palestine Action, regarding its classification as a terrorist organization. The government banned the group last year, leading to thousands of arrests and criminal charges for supporters. This legal challenge seeks to overturn the ban, which the activists argue unfairly restricts freedom of speech and the right to protest.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የፓለስታይን አክሽን ቡድን መስራች የሆኑት ሁዳ አሞሪ ቡድኑ በሽብርተኝነት መፈረጁን በመቃወም ያቀረቡትን ይግባኝ ለመመልከት ተስማምቷል። መንግስት ባለፈው ዓመት ቡድኑን ከከለከለ በኋላ፣ የቡድኑ ደጋፊዎች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለው በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ክሶች ተመሰርተውባቸዋል። አክቲቪስቶቹ ይህ እገዳ የመናገር እና የመቃወም መብትን የሚጥስ ነው በሚል ፍርድ ቤቱ ውሳኔውን እንዲሽርላቸው እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa biyya Ingiliz (UK) dhaabbata 'Palestine Action' jedhamu irratti yakka shororkeessummaan erga himatamee booda, hundeessaan dhaabbatichaa Hudaa Ammori murtii kana mormuun gubbaa geessisanii turan. Mootummaan waggaa darbe dhaabbaticha erga dhorkee booda, deggertoonni kumaatamaatti lakkaa'aman hidhaman. Abbootii murtii kana dura turan murtiin kun seeraan ala miti jedhanis, amma murtichi gara mana murtii olaanaatti kan darbe yoo ta'u, himatatoonni kun mirga yaada ibsachuu fi hiriira ba'uu irratti dhiibbaa uumameera jedhanii falmatu.

title: Three children among eight dead in Russian strikes on Ukraine, officials say
english: A massive Russian overnight missile and drone attack across Ukraine has resulted in the deaths of eight people, including three children. The strikes caused significant destruction to homes and infrastructure, particularly near Kryvyi Rih, while also leading to reports of a stray missile entering Polish territory. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky highlighted the severity of the bombardment following his recent diplomatic efforts to secure advanced defensive equipment from the United States.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ላይ በፈጸመችው መጠነ ሰፊ የሚሳኤልና የድሮን ጥቃት ሶስት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ስምንት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱ በተለይም በክሪቪ ሪህ አካባቢ በበርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶችና መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ከዚህም በላይ ጥቃቱ የተካሄደበት የሚሳኤል አካል ወደ ፖላንድ ድንበር መግባቱ የተነገረ ሲሆን፣ የዩክሬን ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ አገሪቱ ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የላቀ የመከላከያ መሳሪያ ማግኘት እንደሚያስፈልጋት አስገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Raashiyaan gadii guutuu Ukrainii irratti mitsi'elii fi droonii guddoodhaan ergiiteen namoota saddeet du'aniiru; isaan keessaa sadii ijoollee dha. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa hedduu irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera, keessattuu naannoo Kryvyi Rihitti. Gama biraatiin, mitsi'eliin tokko daangaa Poorlaand cabsee seenuun gabaasameera; pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimir Zeelenskiis biyyi isaanii meeshaalee ittisaa ammayyaa Ameerikaarraa argachuun barbaachisaa ta'uu cimsee dubbateera.

title: Police arrest dozens at London rally supporting Palestine Action
english: British police detained a large number of protesters who gathered outside a London courthouse to demonstrate support for the group Palestine Action. The rally was organized by activists who argue that the government's recent decision to label the group a terrorist organization threatens civil liberties. This event serves as the first major test regarding public assembly for Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s new administration.
amharic: የብሪታንያ ፖሊስ በለንደን ፍርድ ቤት አደባባይ ለፍልስጤም አክሽን ቡድን ድጋፍ ለመስጠት በተሰበሰቡ በርካታ ተቃዋሚዎች ላይ እስር አከናውኗል። ሰልፉን ያዘጋጁት አክቲቪስቶች ቡድኑ በአሸባሪነት እንዲፈረጅ መደረጉ የዜጎችን መብት የሚጋፋ ነው ብለዋል። ይህ ክስተት ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም አዲስ ስልጣን ከያዙ ወዲህ ለሕዝባዊ ተቃውሞዎች የሰጡት የመጀመሪያው ምላሽ ተደርጎ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Poolisiin biyya Ingiliz garee 'Palestine Action' deggaruuf mana murtiin London dura walgahii bahaniirratti namoota hedduu to'annoo jala oolche. Walgahii kana kan qindeessan hiriirtonni, mootummaan garee kana 'shororkeessaa' jechuun moggaasuun isaa mirga namoomaa fi bilisummaa sarbuu dha jedhu. Kuniis bulchiinsa haaraa muummicha ministeeraa Andy Burnham jalatti hiriira mormii uummataa mudate isa jalqabaa dha.

title: El Salvador sentences gang members to 1,000 years in prison
english: El Salvador has issued massive prison sentences totaling over 1,000 years to several gang members. These harsh penalties are a result of a major security operation launched by President Nayib Bukele in 2022. The campaign aims to dismantle gang influence within the country through a strict crackdown.
amharic: ኤል ሳልቫዶር በበርካታ የጋንግ አባላት ላይ ከ1,000 ዓመት በላይ የሚዘል የረጅም ጊዜ የእስር ቅጣት አስተላልፋለች። ይህ ጠንካራ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በፕሬዝዳንት ናዪብ ቡኬሌ እ.ኤ.አ. በ2022 በተጀመረው ሰፊ የፀጥታ ዘመቻ ነው። ዘመቻው በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለውን የጋንግ ቡድኖች ተፅዕኖ ለመቀነስ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: El Salvador miseensota garee yakkaatiif hidhaa waggaa 1,000 ol ta'u murteessiteetti. Adabbiin cimaan kun kan dhufte erga Pirezidaanti Naayib Buukeelen bara 2022 doorsisa garee yakkaatiin walqabatee tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuu eegalanii booda. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii keessatti dhiibbaa garee yakkaa kanaa hir'isuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: ‘Go back to your own country’: NZ foreign minister faces backlash
english: New Zealand’s Foreign Minister, Winston Peters, is receiving widespread criticism for telling a Chinese-born lawmaker to return to their home country during a legislative session. This racially charged comment has sparked significant outrage within New Zealand. Additionally, the Chinese government has officially requested that New Zealand officials refrain from involving Beijing in their local political arguments.

title: Sudan’s RSF vows to return to Khartoum
english: Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, the leader of Sudan's Rapid Support Forces, has issued a video command for his troops to capture the capital city, Khartoum. This announcement coincides with the intensification of military conflict in North Kordofan and a worsening humanitarian situation across the country. These developments highlight the ongoing instability and the escalating violence between rival factions in Sudan.

title: England appoint Root and Fleming as Test cricket captain and coach
english: England has appointed Joe Root as their new Test cricket captain and Stephen Fleming as the head coach. Root returns to the leadership role following the retirement of Ben Stokes, while Fleming takes over from Brendon McCullum to help improve the team's performance. The pair will officially begin their partnership following an upcoming home series against Pakistan.

title: How does a safe zone in Lebanon become a target three times?
english: The article examines the ongoing conflict in Lebanon, specifically questioning why areas previously designated as safe zones have been repeatedly struck by Israeli military forces. It highlights the vulnerability of these locations and the uncertainty regarding civilian protection amidst escalating violence. The report aims to analyze the strategic and humanitarian implications of these repeated attacks on areas meant to be secure.

title: Israeli strikes kill at least four, including children, across Gaza Strip
english: Israeli airstrikes across the Gaza Strip have killed at least four people, including two children, despite an ongoing ceasefire agreement. These attacks hit civilian areas such as Khan Younis, Bureij refugee camp, and Gaza City, causing further displacement and injuries to dozens of people. The violence occurred while Hamas representatives were in Cairo meeting with international mediators to discuss the implementation of a long-term truce.

title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
english: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk stated that a missile which crashed into a field in eastern Poland was likely launched by Russia during a major attack on Ukraine. Although the impact created a large crater, no injuries were reported because it landed in an unpopulated area. Polish officials are currently conducting a detailed investigation to confirm the exact origin and type of the weapon involved.

title: Thousands evacuated in Crete as European wildfires continue to rage
english: Severe wildfires in Crete have forced the evacuation of approximately 8,000 residents and tourists due to intense winds and uncontrollable flames. The fires have already caused tragic loss of life, including three firefighters, and have destroyed homes and farmland across the region. Authorities are struggling to contain the blaze, as extreme weather conditions continue to threaten parts of Greece and neighboring countries.

title: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
english: Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega has proposed a constitutional reform to extend the presidential term by an additional year. This move is part of broader changes that aim to legally prevent political opponents labeled as traitors from participating in future elections. Ortega, who has been in power since 2007, has consistently consolidated his authority by removing term limits and positioning his wife as co-president.
amharic: የኒካራጓው ፕሬዚዳንት ዳንኤል ኦርቴጋ የፕሬዚዳንታዊ የስልጣን ዘመንን በአንድ ዓመት ለማራዘም የሚያስችል የሕገ መንግሥት ማሻሻያ አቅርበዋል። ይህ እርምጃ መንግሥት እንደ ከሃዲ የሚቆጥራቸውን ተቃዋሚዎች ከምርጫ ውድድር ለማገድ ያለመ ነው። ከ2007 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ስልጣን ላይ ያሉት ኦርቴጋ፣ ከዚህ ቀደም የፕሬዚዳንትነት የስልጣን ዘመን ገደቦችን በማንሳት እና ሚስታቸውን በምክትል ፕሬዚዳንትነት በመሰየም ስልጣናቸውን እያጠናከሩ መጥተዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Niikaaraaguwaa Daani'eel Oortegaa yeroo turtiisaanii kan pireezidaantummaa waggaa tokkoon dheeressuuf fooyya'iinsa seera bu'uuraa dhiyeessaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun mormitoota mootummaan akka gadootutti ilaalu fuulduratti hirmaannaa filannoo irraa dhowwuuf kan gargaaruudha. Oortegaa bara 2007 irraa eegalee aangoorra jiran, yeroo turtiirratti daangaa ka’e kaasuudhaan akkasumas haati warraasaanii pireezidaantii waliinii ta’anii akka muudaman gochuudhaan aangoo isaanii jabeeffataa jiru.

title: AFC president doubles down on FIFA, calling World Cup plan ‘unacceptable’
english: The president of the Asian Football Confederation, Sheikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa, has strongly criticized FIFA for its plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors without prior consultation. He argues that this unilateral move threatens the existing structure of international football and demands a more transparent review process. Additionally, the AFC expressed concern over the short timeframe provided for member associations to approve this major financial proposal.
amharic: የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ሼክ ሳልማን ቢን ኢብራሂም አል ካሊፋ፣ ፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ያቀደውን እቅድ አስቀድሞ ሳያማክር ማቅረቡን በጥብቅ ተቃውመዋል። ይህ አካሄድ ዓለም አቀፍ የእግር ኳስ መዋቅርን አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥል የገለጹት ሼክ ሳልማን፣ ጉዳዩ ግልጽ በሆነ የህግ አግባብ እንዲታይ ጠይቀዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ አባል ሀገራት ይህንን ትልቅ የፋይናንስ እቅድ በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ እንዲያፀድቁ መገደዳቸው አሳሳቢ መሆኑን ኮንፌዴሬሽኑ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantii Gamtaa Kubbaa Miillaa Eeshiyaa, Sheikh Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa, FIFA qooda waancaa addunyaa investaroota dhuunfaatti gurguruuf karoorfatee marii malee ifa godhuun isaa akka hin fudhatamne ibsaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun sirna kubbaa miillaa idil-addunyaa kan miidhuu fi adeemsa iftoomina qabu akka barbaadu gaafataniiru. Kana malees, gamtichi miseensonni isaanii karoora gurguddaa akkasii akka hatattamaan akka mirkaneessan dhiibbaan irratti uumamuun isaa akka isaan yaaddesse ibseera.

title: Israeli raids and settler attacks intensify across the occupied West Bank
english: Israeli military forces have arrested at least 15 Palestinians during recent overnight operations throughout the occupied West Bank. Simultaneously, the region is experiencing a surge in violent attacks by Israeli settlers. The United Nations has raised alarms, noting that these incidents of settler-led violence have reached unprecedented levels.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባደረጉት የምሽት ኦፕሬሽን ቢያንስ 15 ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ በእስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸሙ የጥቃት ድርጊቶች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምረዋል። የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደገለጸው፣ እነዚህ በሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸሙ የጥቃት ድርጊቶች ከምንጊዜውም በላይ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሰዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el naannoo Qilleensaa (West Bank) keessatti halkan guutuu duula gaggeessaniin Palastayinoota 15 ol ta'an to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaatuuttis, weerartoonni Israa'el miidhaa fi haleellaa raawwatan daran dabaleera. Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, haleellaan weerartootaan raawwatamu kun hanga ammaatti sadarkaa olaanaa irra ga'eera.

title: Attack on northwest Pakistan police post kills 11 officers
english: At least 11 police officers were killed and many others injured during a violent ambush on a security checkpoint in Pakistan's Hangu district near the Afghan border. The attackers utilized explosive-laden drones before engaging in a prolonged gun battle with security forces, resulting in the deaths of 15 militants. While no group has claimed responsibility for this specific attack, it follows a recent surge in regional violence and ongoing tensions between Pakistan and Afghanistan.
amharic: በፓኪስታን እና በአፍጋኒስታን ድንበር አቅራቢያ በሚገኘው የሃንጉ አውራጃ በፖሊስ ጣቢያ ላይ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 11 የፖሊስ አባላት ተገድለዋል። አጥቂዎቹ ፈንጂ የጫኑ ድሮኖችን ከተጠቀሙ በኋላ ከጸጥታ ኃይሎች ጋር ረጅም ሰዓታት የቆየ የተኩስ ልውውጥ አድርገው 15 የሚሆኑ አጥቂዎች ተገድለዋል። ምንም እንኳን እስካሁን ለጥቃቱ ኃላፊነቱን የወሰደ አካል ባይኖርም፣ በሁለቱ አገራት ድንበር አካባቢ እየተባባሰ የመጣው ግጭት ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Godina Hangu kan Paakistaanitti argamu keessatti buufata poolisii tokko irratti haleellaa raawwatameen poolisoonni 11 yoo du'an, kanneen biroo hedduun immoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellicha raawwattoonni kunis dirooniin qaraxoota boombii fe'an fayyadamuun booda, humnoota nageenyaa waliin sa'aatii dheeraaf wal-waraansuun haleeltota 15 ajjeesuun danda'ameera. Haleellaa kanaaf eenyuyyuu harka akka qabu ifatti kan hin ibsine ta'us, naannawa daangaa Paakistaanii fi Afgaanistaanitti waraanni dabalaa dhufuun isaa yaaddoo uumee jira.

title: Several children killed and wounded in Israeli attacks across Gaza
english: Israeli military strikes targeted several locations across Gaza overnight, resulting in the deaths and injuries of multiple children. The attacks impacted residential buildings in Gaza City and areas in al-Mawasi where displaced families were living in tents. Eyewitness reports confirm that a significant number of the casualties from these strikes are minors.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት በጋዛ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ በመፈጸሙ በርካታ ሕፃናት ተገድለዋል እንዲሁም ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቶቹ በጋዛ ከተማ በሚገኙ መኖሪያ ቤቶች እና ተፈናቃዮች መጠለያ በሆኑ ድንኳኖች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ነበሩ። ከአደጋው የተረፉ የአይን እማኞች እንደገለጹት፣ በጥቃቱ ከተጎዱት መካከል አብዛኛዎቹ ሕፃናት ናቸው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el halkan keessa iddoowwan garaa garaa Gaazaatti haleellaa geggeesseen ijoolleen hedduun ajjeefamaniiru akkasumas miidhaan irra ga'eera. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa magaalaa Gaazaa fi dunkaana godaantotni itti qubatan bakka Al-Mawaasii jedhamutti xiyyeeffatee raawwatame. Ragaan ijaan argan akka ibsanitti, miidhaan kun namoota irratti ga'e keessaa ijoolleen baay'een isaanii ta'uun mirkanaa'eera.

title: Why is Saudi Arabia forming a coalition to protect the Red Sea?
english: Saudi Arabia is leading an international effort to create a naval alliance to secure shipping routes in the Red Sea against attacks from Yemen's Houthi rebels. The coalition, which is expected to be based in Riyadh, aims to counter maritime blockades and threats to oil exports that have disrupted global energy supplies. Several nations, including Egypt, Sudan, and Djibouti, have already signaled their intent to join as the kingdom seeks to stabilize the region amidst rising geopolitical tensions.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ በየመን በሚገኙ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚደርስባቸውን የባህር ላይ ጥቃቶች ለመከላከል በቀይ ባህር ላይ ዓለም አቀፍ የባህር ኃይል ጥምረት እየመሰረተች ነው። ይህ ጥምረት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ያለውን የንግድ መርከቦች መስተጓጎል ለመግታት ያለመ ነው። ግብፅን፣ ሱዳንን እና ጅቡቲን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሀገራት ጥምረቱን ለመቀላቀል ፍላጎት ያሳዩ ሲሆን፣ ዋና መሥሪያ ቤቱም በሪያድ እንደሚቋቋም ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan hujii gamtaa waraana galaanaa idil-addunyaa kan naannoo galaana Diimaa eeguuf karoorfame hogganaa jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, finciltota Huutii kan Yaman keessa jiran irraa miidhaan daldala galaanaa fi qulqullina boba'aa addunyaa irratti ga'u dhaabuufi. Biyyoonni akka Gibxii, Sudaan fi Jibuutii gamtaa kana keessatti hirmaachuuf fedhii agarsiisaniiru, akkasumas qaamni kun waajjira isaa Riyaad keessatti akka banu ibsameera.

title: Veteran Ugandan opposition leader collapses in court and in ICU, his wife says
english: Kizza Besigye, a prominent Ugandan opposition leader currently facing treason charges, has been admitted to the ICU after collapsing in court. His wife, Winnie Byanyima, reported that he is unconscious and is refusing medical care from government staff while demanding access to his private physician. Besigye has been in detention since his abduction in Kenya last year, and his case remains a focal point of political tension in Uganda.
amharic: የኡጋንዳው የተቃዋሚ መሪ ኪዛ ቤሲግዬ በክስ ሂደት ላይ በነበሩበት ወቅት አቅማቸው ተዳክሞ በመውደቃቸው ወደ ከፍተኛ እንክብካቤ ክፍል (ICU) መግባታቸው ተገለጸ። ባለቤታቸው ዊኒ ብያኒማ እንዳስታወቁት፣ ቤሲግዬ ንቃተ ህሊናቸውን ስተው እንደሚገኙ እና የመንግስት ዶክተሮች እንዲያክሟቸው ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። እሳቸውም የግል ሐኪማቸው እንዲያያቸው ቢጠይቁም፣ እስካሁን በከፍተኛ ጥበቃ ስር በህክምና ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hogganaan mormituu biyya Yugaandaa Kizza Besigye mana murtiitti osoo jiranu kufanii, amma hospitaala keessatti wal'aansa hatattamaa (ICU) argachaa jiru. Haati warraa isaanii Wiinii Biyaanimaa akka ibsanitti, Besigye quba hin qaban akkasumas ogeeyyota fayyaa mootummaatiin yaalamuu didanii jiru. Waggaa darbe irraa kaasee hidhaa kan jiran hogganaan kun, himannaa gara jabinaa fi mootummaa fonqolchuun himatamuun isaanii ni yaadatama.

title: Saudi Arabia confirmed to host Asian Champions League Elite finals
english: Saudi Arabia has officially been selected to host the Asian Champions League Elite finals for the next three years. The country previously hosted the first two editions of the tournament following its recent restructuring. This elite competition features top clubs from across the continent and is set to expand its league phase to 32 teams starting in the upcoming season.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ ለቀጣዮቹ ሶስት አመታት የእስያ ሻምፒዮንስ ሊግ ኤሊት ፍጻሜ ውድድርን ለማስተናገድ በይፋ ተመርጣለች። አገሪቱ ከውድድሩ መዋቅር ለውጥ በኋላ የተካሄዱትን የመጀመሪያዎቹን ሁለት የፍጻሜ ውድድሮች አስተናግዳለች። ይህ ከፍተኛ የክለቦች ውድድር በመላው አህጉሪቱ የሚገኙ ምርጥ ክለቦችን የሚያሳትፍ ሲሆን፣ በሚቀጥለው የውድድር ዘመን የሊግ ምዕራፉን ወደ 32 ቡድኖች ለማሳደግ ታቅዷል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan waggoota sadan dhufaniif tapha xumuraa 'Asian Champions League Elite' akka qopheessitu mirkanaa'eera. Biyyattiin qophiiwwan lamaan darban erga riiformiin taphichaa godhamee booda qopheessitee turte. Dorgommiin kun kilaboota gurguddoo ardittii hunda walitti fiduuf kan qophaaye yoo ta'u, waancaa dhufu irraa jalqabee gareewwan 32 akka hirmaatan taasifameera.

title: Infantino insists FIFA’s World Cup plan is proposal and not ‘obligation’
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has defended a controversial proposal to sell a 20 percent stake in a new $20 billion commercial subsidiary to private investors. The plan faced strong backlash from regional football authorities who felt excluded from the decision-making process. Infantino emphasized that this is only a consultation proposal and not a mandatory change, asserting that FIFA will maintain full control over the sport.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ አዲስ የ20 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ንዑስ ድርጅት በማቋቋም 20 በመቶ ድርሻውን ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ያቀረቡትን እቅድ ተከላክለዋል። ይህ ሀሳብ በውሳኔ አሰጣጡ ሂደት ውስጥ እንዳልተሳተፉ የሚናገሩ የክልል እግር ኳስ ማህበራት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ኢንፋንቲኖ ግን ይህ እቅድ አስገዳጅ ሳይሆን ለውይይት የቀረበ ሃሳብ ብቻ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ፊፋ የእግር ኳስ ጨዋታውን ሙሉ ቁጥጥር እንደሚያደርግ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin FIFA Jaanii Infantiinoo dhaabbata haaraa guddina isaa doolaara biliyoona 20 ta'uuf qophiirra jiru irratti harka 20 investaroota dhuunfaatti gurguruuf karoorfatan ittisuun dubbataniiru. Karoorri kun qaamolee kubbaa miillaa naannoowwanii kan mufachiise yoo ta'u, isaanis murtee kana keessatti hirmaachisni akka hin jirre ibsaniiru. Infantiinoon garuu kun dirqama osoo hin taane yaada mariif dhiyaate qofa akka ta'e fi FIFA kubbaa miillaa irratti to'annoo guutuu akka qabaatu mirkaneessaniiru.

title: US strikes cause extensive damage on Iran’s Qeshm Island
english: The United States conducted significant military strikes against targets on Iran’s Qeshm Island, resulting in widespread destruction. Iranian officials reported that a residential building was hit, leading to the tragic deaths of two adults and their young child, along with injuries to two other minors. These attacks follow a recent military incident involving the US in Jordan.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአይራን ቂሽም ደሴት ላይ ባደረሰችው መጠነ ሰፊ የአየር ጥቃት ከፍተኛ ውድመት ደርሷል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ ቤትን በመምታቱ ሁለት አዋቂዎች እና የአንድ ዓመት የሁለት ዓመት ህጻን ህይወታቸው ሲያልፍ ሁለት ሌሎች ህጻናትም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በዮርዳኖስ ከተፈጸመው የቅርብ ጊዜ የጦርነት እንቅስቃሴ ጋር ተያይዞ የተወሰደ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Ameerikaan weerara humnaan guutame naannoo odoollaa Qeshm kan Iraan irratti gaggeessiteen miidhaan bal'aan gahee jira. Aangeyyoonni Iraan akka ibsanitti, weerarichi mana jireenyaa tokko rukutuun isaa abbaa manaa, haadha manaa fi ijoollee isaanii waggaa lamaa ajjeeseera; akkasumas ijoolleen biroo lama midhamaniiru. Weerarri kun tarkaanfii Ameerikaan Yordaanos keessatti mudannoo waraanaa erga mudatee booda fudhatte dha.

title: Is Israel repeating the Crusaders’ fatal mistake?
english: A new Al Jazeera podcast series called 'Deja Vu' investigates historical parallels between the Crusader kingdom and modern Israel. The program examines how the 11th-century Crusader state ultimately collapsed after less than a century due to internal and external pressures. It questions whether current political dynamics suggest that Israel might face a similar fate as it navigates conflicts in the region.
amharic: አልጀዚራ 'ዴጃ ቩ' በተሰኘ አዲስ የፖድካስት ፕሮግራሙ፣ በመካከለኛው ዘመን የነበረው የመስቀላውያን መንግሥት እና አሁን ያለው የእስራኤል ሁኔታ ያላቸውን ተመሳሳይነት ይዳስሳል። ፕሮግራሙ የ11ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን የመስቀላውያን ግዛት ከውስጥ እና ከውጭ በተፈጠሩ ጫናዎች እንዴት በአንድ ክፍለ ዘመን ባልሞላ ጊዜ ውስጥ እንደወደቀ ይተነትናል። ይህንንም ታሪካዊ ክስተት መሰረት በማድረግ፣ አሁን ያለው የእስራኤል የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ተመሳሳይ ውድቀት ሊገጥመው ይችላል ወይ የሚለውን ጥያቄ ያነሳል።
oromo: Podcastiin 'Deja Vu' jedhamu kan Al Jazeera, walitti dhufeenya seenaa Mootummaa Masqalootaa (Crusaders) fi haala yeroo ammaa Israa'el gidduu jiru qorata. Sagantaan kun, mootummaan Masqalootaa bara 1099 hundeeffame dhiibbaa gara garaatiin waggaa dhibba tokko hin guunne keessatti akkamitti akka kufe ibsa. Seenaa kana kaasuun, haalli siyaasaa fi waraana har'aa Israa'el keessa jiru gara fuulduraatti bu'aa wal-fakkaataa qabaachuu danda'a moo miti kan jedhu gaaffii keessa galcha.

title: India’s arms sale to Israel risks complicity in Gaza genocide, Amnesty says
english: Amnesty International has accused India of facilitating potential war crimes by supplying military components to Israel during the conflict in Gaza. A report reveals that Indian companies have shipped hundreds of thousands of parts for weapons, explosives, and military vehicles to Israeli defense manufacturers since October 2023. The organization argues that these exports make India complicit in the humanitarian crisis, urging a halt to such shipments amid ongoing international legal concerns regarding genocide.
amharic: አምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል ህንድ በጋዛ በሚካሄደው ጦርነት ወቅት ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ መለዋወጫዎችን በማቅረብ ለጦር ወንጀሎች ተባባሪ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ከሰሰ። የቡድኑ ሪፖርት እንደሚያሳየው፣ ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ የህንድ ኩባንያዎች በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የጦር መሳሪያ፣ የፈንጂ እና ወታደራዊ ተሽከርካሪ መለዋወጫዎችን ለእስራኤል የመከላከያ አምራቾች ልከዋል። ይህ ድርጊት ህንድ በሰብአዊ ቀውሱ ውስጥ ተባባሪ እንድትሆን እንደሚያደርጋት የገለጸው ድርጅቱ፣ እየተባባሰ በመጣው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ክስ ምክንያት ህንድ እነዚህን የጦር መሳሪያ አቅርቦቶች እንድታቆም አሳስቧል።
oromo: Amnesty International akka gabaasetti, Hindaan waraana Gaaza keessatti raawwatamaa jiruuf meeshaalee waraanaa Israa’eliif dhiyeessuun yakka waraanaa keessatti hirmaachuu danda’uun himateera. Gabaasichi akka ibsutti, Hindaan qondaaltota Israa’el waliin walitti dhufeenya cimaa qabaachuun, Onkoloolessa 2023 irraa eegalee meeshaalee waraanaa, rasaasa fi kutaalee konkolaataa waraanaa hedduu gara Israa’elitti ergaa tureera. Dhaabbatichi, gochi kun Hindaan balaa namoomaa fi yakka sanyii balleessuu irratti harka akka qabaattu taasisa jedhee waan amanuuf, dhiyeessii kana akka dhaabdu gaafateera.

title: Israeli air attacks kill six Palestinians in Gaza overnight
english: Israeli airstrikes conducted overnight across the Gaza Strip have resulted in the deaths of six Palestinians and left 25 others injured. These new casualties are part of an ongoing military campaign in the region. Medical officials have confirmed the rising toll as the intense bombardment continues.
amharic: ባለፈው ሌሊት በተለያዩ የጋዛ ሰርጥ አካባቢዎች በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ስድስት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ 25 ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ቀጣይ የቦምብ ድብደባ የሟቾችን ቁጥር ከፍ አድርጎታል። የሕክምና ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ጉዳቱ እየጨመረ መምጣቱን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Halkan darbe qilleensa irraa haleellaa Israa'el naannoo Gazaatti gaggeessiteen namoonni ja'a ajjeefamanii 25 ammoo madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun tarkaanfii waraana biyyattii kan daangaa tokko malee itti fufe keessatti kan dabalameedha. Maddi oduu fayyaa akka mirkaneessetti, haleellaa hammaataa kanaan baay'inni namoota miidhamanii dabalaa jira.

title: Why the New York Times story on Mossad recruiting Ahmadinejad doesn't add up
english: A recent New York Times report claims that Israel's intelligence agency, the Mossad, recruited former Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad to influence Iran's political future. However, experts and former intelligence officials argue the story is highly improbable, noting that Ahmadinejad lacks the real power held by Iran's Supreme Leader and the Revolutionary Guard. Furthermore, the operational details, such as the Mossad chief personally meeting the former president at a public conference, contradict standard security protocols.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ታይምስ የቅርብ ጊዜ ዘገባ የእስራኤል የደህንነት መስሪያ ቤት ሞሳድ፣ የቀድሞውን የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማህሙድ አህመዲኔጃድን የአገሪቱን የፖለቲካ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ለመቆጣጠር እንደላከው ይናገራል። ሆኖም ባለሙያዎች እና የቀድሞ የደህንነት ባለስልጣናት ታሪኩ ተአማኒነት የሌለው መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ አህመዲኔጃድ በኢራን ከፍተኛ መሪዎች እና በሪቮሉሽነሪ ጋርድ ዘንድ ምንም አይነት ትክክለኛ ስልጣን እንደሌላቸው ይገልጻሉ። በተጨማሪም፣ የሞሳድ ዋና ዳይሬክተር በግል በይፋዊ ኮንፈረንስ ላይ የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንቱን መገናኘታቸው ተራ የአሰራር ደንቦችን የሚጻረር በመሆኑ ታሪኩ ጥርጣሬን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gabaasni 'New York Times' dhiheenya kana baase, mootummaan Israa'el fi sagantaan basaastota ishee 'Mossad' pirezidaantii duraanii Iraan Maahmuda Ahimadiinejaad, gara fuulduraatti bulchiinsa Iraan to'achuuf akka fayyadaman hima. Haa ta'u malee, ogeeyyiin fi basaastonnii duraanii himata kana kan morman yoo ta'u, Ahimadiinejaad humna siyaasaa dhugaa kan qaban hoggantoota olaanoo fi waraana 'Revolutionary Guard' ta'uu isaa eeru. Kana malee, hogganaan Mossad akkaataa namoota gidduutti wal arguun isaa fi yaadni walga'ii idilee irratti wal arguu qabatamaa miti jedhamee shakkama.

title: Egypt says drone attack sparked fire on American LNG ships
english: Egyptian authorities have confirmed that a drone attack triggered a fire on two American-owned natural gas vessels at the port of Damietta. While no injuries were reported and no group has claimed responsibility, officials have launched a formal investigation into the security breach. This incident has sparked concerns that the ongoing regional conflict is expanding, as it is the first such attack on Egyptian soil during the current crisis.
amharic: የግብፅ ባለስልጣናት በዳሚዬታ ወደብ በሚገኙ ሁለት የአሜሪካ የጋዝ ማጓጓዣ መርከቦች ላይ የደረሰው የእሳት አደጋ በድሮን ጥቃት መከሰቱን አረጋግጠዋል። ምንም እንኳን ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሰው ባይኖርም እና ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው አካል ባይታወቅም፣ መንግስት የጸጥታ ጥሰቱን በቁም ነገር በመመልከት ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። ይህ ጥቃት አሁን ባለው የክልሉ ግጭት ውስጥ ግብፅን በአዲስ መልክ ማካተቱ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan Masrii dooniiwwan gaazii kan Ameerikaa lama kan buufata Damietta keessatti gubatan, haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feeneen (drone) akka ta'e mirkaneesseera. Namni miidhame akka hin jirre fi gareen haleellaa kana fudhate akka hin jirre kan ibsame yoo ta'u, mootummaan qorannoo eegalee jira. Haleellaan kun lola naannichaa keessatti Masriin akka hirmaattu godhuun isaa sodaa guddaa uumeera.

title: Israeli drones target southern Lebanese town in Tyre
english: Israeli drones conducted an aerial strike on the Mashaa al-Mansouri region near the city of Tyre in southern Lebanon. Official reports from Lebanese state media indicate that the attack took place recently. Authorities have not yet released any information regarding potential injuries or the extent of the property damage caused by the assault.
amharic: የእስራኤል ድሮኖች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የታየር ከተማ አካባቢ ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። የሊባኖስ የመንግስት መገናኛ ብዙሃን እንደዘገቡት ጥቃቱ በማሻ አል-ማንሱሪ አካባቢ የተፈጸመ ነው። እስካሁን ድረስ በደረሰው ጥቃት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ወይም የንብረት ውድመት ስለመኖሩ የተገለጸ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Xiyyaaronni malee kan Israa'el magaalaa Xaayir kan kibba Libaanoositti argamtu irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Miidiyaaleen mootummaa Libaanoos akka gabaasanitti, haleellaan kun naannoo Maashaa al-Mansuuritti kan raawwatame dha. Hammamtaan miidhaa lubbuu fi qabeenyaa haleellaa kanaan ga'ee hanga ammaatti ifatti hin ba'in jiru.

title: Watch: Search operations for victims of US strike in Qeshm, where three were found killed
english: Iranian state media released footage showing rescue workers searching through the debris of a home on Qeshm Island after a US military strike. The attack resulted in the deaths of three family members, including a young child. Two other children survived the incident and have been taken to a hospital for medical care.
amharic: የኢራን የመንግስት ሚዲያ በኬሽም ደሴት ላይ በአሜሪካ የደረሰው የአየር ጥቃት የመኖሪያ ቤትን እንዳፈረሰ የሚያሳይ ምስል ይፋ አድርጓል። በዚህ ጥቃት አንድ ሕፃንን ጨምሮ የአንድ ቤተሰብ ሦስት አባላት ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ሁለት የተረፉ ልጆች ደግሞ ለሕክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል ተልከዋል።
oromo: Miidiyaan mootummaa Iraan akka gabaasetti, haleellaa qilleensaa Ameerikaan odoola Qeshm irratti raawwatteen mana jireenyaa tokko diigameera. Haleellaa kanaan miseensonni maatii sadii kan du’an yoo ta’u, isaan keessaa daa’imni tokko ni argama. Daa’imman sadarkaa kana irraa lubbuun hafan lama immoo yaala argachuuf gara hospitaalaatti ergamaniiru.

title: Viral finger-clicker suspended as cricket storm remains in global spotlight
english: An amateur cricketer from Saltburn Cricket Club has been suspended indefinitely following allegations that he used finger-clicking to deceive umpires. The player allegedly mimicked the sound of the ball hitting the bat to incorrectly influence decisions, with video evidence of the act gaining international attention. The club is currently working with the local league to investigate the incident and has asked for privacy during the process.
amharic: የሰልትበርን ክሪኬት ክለብ ተጫዋች ዳኞችን ለማታለል በጣት የመጫጫን ድምፅ ተጠቅሟል በሚል ክስ ከጨዋታ ታግዷል። ተጫዋቹ ኳሱ ከባት ጋር እንደተገናኘ ለማስመሰል የጣት ድምፅ በማውጣት ዳኞችን ለማሳሳት ሞክሯል የሚለው ቪዲዮ ዓለም አቀፍ ትኩረት አግኝቷል። ክለቡ ከሊጉ ጋር በመተባበር ጉዳዩን እያጣራ ሲሆን፣ ምርመራው እስኪጠናቀቅ ድረስ ተጫዋቹ ከማንኛውም ውድድር ታግዶ እንዲቆይ ተወስኗል።
oromo: Taphatni kilabii kirikeetii Saltburn tokko, abbaa murtiin (umpire) akka dogoggoruuf quba isaa walitti rukutuudhaan sagalee sobaa uume jedhamee shakkamee addunyaa irratti hordofamaa jira. Taphatni kun kubbaan biitii (bat) irra gaheera jedhanii akka yaadaniif sagalee sobaa uumuu isaa viidiyoon agarsiisu kun babal’ateera. Kilabichi dhimma kana irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiruuf taphaticha yeroo hin murtoofneef tapha irraa dhorkeera.

title: War and shortages push Gaza hospitals to breaking point
english: Gaza’s healthcare system is facing a catastrophic collapse due to ongoing conflict and severe supply shortages. Vital medical facilities have been destroyed or forced to close, leaving thousands of patients, including those needing dialysis, without life-saving treatment. Consequently, individuals suffering from chronic conditions and trauma are dying at alarming rates as hospitals struggle to operate with limited resources.
amharic: በጋዛ ያለው የጤና አገልግሎት በጦርነቱ እና በህክምና ቁሳቁስ እጥረት ምክንያት ሙሉ በሙሉ የመፈራረስ አደጋ ተጋርጦበታል። አስፈላጊ የህክምና ተቋማት በመውደማቸው ወይም በመዘጋታቸው የኩላሊት እጥበት የሚያስፈልጋቸው ታካሚዎችን ጨምሮ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ህይወት አድን ህክምና ማግኘት ተስኗቸዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት፣ በከባድ ህመም እና በጦርነቱ ጉዳት ላይ ያሉ ሰዎች በቂ ድጋፍ ማግኘት ባለመቻላቸው በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየሞቱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: sirni fayyaa Gaaza keessaa waraanaafi hanqina meeshaalee wal’aansaa irraa kan ka’e kufaatii hamaa keessa jira. Buufatni fayyaa hedduun kan manca’aniifi cufaman yoo ta’u, kunis dhukkubsattoota hedduu keessattuu kanneen dhiiga dhiqachuu qaban du’aaf saaxilee jira. Sababa hanqina meeshaaleefi rakkoo hospitaalotaa kanaan, namoonni dhukkuba cimaafi miidhaa waraanaan qabaman wal’aansa argachuu dadhabanii lubbuun isaanii darbaa jira.

title: US launches ‘powerful’ strikes on Iran after Jordan attack
english: The United States military has carried out a series of intense airstrikes against several cities in southern Iran, including Ahvaz and Abadan. This operation was conducted as a direct response to a previous attack on American forces stationed in Jordan. President Donald Trump emphasized that these strikes were intended to be a significant retaliatory measure against the Iranian government.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በአህቫዝ እና በአባዳንን ጨምሮ በደቡባዊ ኢራን በሚገኙ በርካታ ከተሞች ላይ መጠነ ሰፊ የአየር ድብደባዎችን ፈጽመዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው በዮርዳኖስ ውስጥ በሰፈሩ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ላይ ለደረሰው ጥቃት አጸፋዊ እርምጃ ለመውሰድ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ይህ እርምጃ በኢራን ላይ የሚወሰድ ጠንካራ ምላሽ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa magaalota kibba Iraan kanneen akka Ahvaaz fi Abadaanitti haleellaa xiyyaaraa cimaa gaggeesseera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame loltoota Ameerikaa Yordaanos keessa turan irratti haleellaa erga raawwatamee booda haaloo bahuufidha. Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp tarkaanfiin kun mootummaa Iraan irratti kan xiyyeeffate fi humna guddaa kan qabu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Evo Morales defiant after new Bolivia arrest warrant
english: Bolivian authorities have issued a new arrest warrant for former President Evo Morales, accusing him of terrorism and orchestrating an armed uprising. These charges stem from his recent support for widespread protests against the government's economic policies. Morales has dismissed the allegations as a political tactic to distract from the country's ongoing crisis and has vowed not to be intimidated.
amharic: የቦሊቪያ ባለስልጣናት የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት ኤቮ ሞራሌስን በአሸባሪነት እና በመንግስት ላይ የታጠቀ አመጽ በማቀጣጠል በመክሰስ አዲስ የእስር ማዘዣ አውጥተዋል። ክሱ የተመሰረተው በመንግስት የኢኮኖሚ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ የተነሱ ተቃውሞዎችን በመደገፋቸው ነው። ሞራሌስ ክሱ የሀገሪቱን የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ለመሸፈን የተደረገ ፖለቲካዊ ሴራ ነው በማለት ውድቅ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Boliviyaa dura taa'aa biyyattii kan turan Evo Morales irratti, shororkeessummaa fi mootummaa irratti fincila hidhannootti fayyadame kaasuun himatamanii ajajni qabamuu bahee jira. Himannoon kun kan dhufe erga isaan mootummaan qophee siyaasa dinagdee isaa mormuun hiriira bahanii turan booda. Morales himannoo kana mootummaan rakkoo dinagdee biyyattii jiru dhoksuuf jecha irratti dhiyeessan jechuun waakkatan.

title: Rescue operation in Argentina to free more than 100 snow-trapped tourists
english: Emergency teams in Argentina successfully rescued over 100 tourists who were stranded by a heavy snowstorm near the Balcon del Pissis lookout. Authorities utilized heavy equipment to reach the trapped individuals and clear the blocked paths. While most were rescued safely, two people required medical treatment for hypothermia.
amharic: በአርጀንቲና ባልኮን ዴል ፒሲስ አካባቢ በበረዶ አውሎ ንፋስ ተይዘው የነበሩ ከ100 በላይ ቱሪስቶች በአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ድነት ተደረገላቸው። አዳኝ ቡድኖች በረዶውን ለማጽዳት ከባድ ማሽነሪዎችን ተጠቅመዋል። አብዛኛዎቹ ተጎጂዎች በሰላም የተረፉ ሲሆን፣ ሁለት ሰዎች በብርድ ምክንያት ለህክምና ወደ ሆስፒታል ተልከዋል።
oromo: Arjantiinaatti turistoonni 100 ol ta'an naannoo Balcon del Pissis jedhamutti obomboleettii cabbii cimaan erga itti cufamee booda gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa lubbuun hafan. Gareen furmaataa cabbicha kaasuuf maashinoota guguddaa kan fayyadaman yoo ta'u, namoonni hundinuus nageenyaan baafamaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, namoonni lama qorri isaan miidhee gara hospitaalaatti geessisuun isaan barbaachiseera.

title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
english: The United States military conducted significant retaliatory strikes against Iran after Iranian forces attempted to attack American troops in Jordan and naval vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Although all incoming Iranian missiles were intercepted, the US responded by destroying numerous military command centers, drone facilities, and defense sites linked to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. These hostilities mark an escalation in a five-month-long conflict that continues despite earlier hopes for diplomatic negotiations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በዮርዳኖስ እና በሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ ላይ በአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር የሞከረውን ኢራን በመበቀል ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽሟል። ምንም እንኳን ሁሉም የኢራን ሚሳኤሎች ቢከሽፉም፣ አሜሪካ በምላሹ የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃይሎች መቆጣጠሪያ ማዕከላትን እና የጦር መሣሪያ ማከማቻዎችን አውድማለች። ይህ ግጭት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ ይገኛል ተብሎ ቢታሰብም፣ ለአምስት ወራት ያህል እየተባባሰ የቀጠለ ነው።

title: Dramatic sea rescue as firefighters die on the Greek island of Crete
english: Severe wildfires on the Greek island of Crete have necessitated an emergency sea rescue operation by the Coast Guard for those trapped by the flames. Tragically, three firefighters have lost their lives while attempting to combat these blazes, including two on the island and one on the mainland. Authorities are currently working to manage the disaster as the fires continue to pose a significant threat.

title: Why did Anthony Fauci invoke the Fifth Amendment? Senate hearing explained
english: Former US health official Dr. Anthony Fauci recently refused to answer questions at a Senate hearing concerning the COVID-19 pandemic and its origins. Following advice from his legal team, he utilized his Fifth Amendment right to avoid potential self-incrimination while facing intense scrutiny from Republican lawmakers. These officials, led by Senator Rand Paul, are investigating allegations that Fauci misled Congress regarding US-funded research linked to the virus.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ የጤና ባለሙያ ዶክተር አንቶኒ ፋውቺ በኮቪድ-19 ወረርሽኝ መነሻ እና አያያዝ ዙሪያ በሴኔት ኮሚቴ ቀርበው ጥያቄዎችን ለመመለስ ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም። ጠበቆቻቸው በሰጡት ምክር መሰረት፣ ሊከተል የሚችለውን የህግ ተጠያቂነት ለመከላከል ህገ-መንግስታዊ መብታቸውን በመጠቀም ዝምታን መርጠዋል። የሪፐብሊካን ሴናተሮች ዶክተሩ ኮንግረስን አሳስተዋል በሚል ክስ ምርመራ እያካሄዱ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በቻይና ስላደረጉት የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የተደረገለት ምርምርን የሚመለከት ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan tajaajila fayyaa Ameerikaa durii Dr. Anthony Fauci, waa'ee maddaa fi to'annoo dhukkuba COVID-19 ilaalchisee yaa'ii mana maree (Senate) irratti gaaffii deebisuuf fedhii hin qabne. Senatorootni paartii Ripaabilikaanii Dr. Fauci qorannoo Chaayinaa keessatti taasifame irratti Congress gowwoomseera jedhanii waan shakkanif qorannoo kana gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Living with fear: Inside a southern Lebanon village divided by Israel
english: The village of Mansouri in southern Lebanon remains split by a military border known as the Yellow Line, which separates a small portion of occupied Lebanese land from the rest of the country. Residents living near this boundary face daily uncertainty and constant anxiety due to the proximity of Israeli military presence. The ongoing situation has left the local population in a state of persistent fear as they navigate life in a deeply divided territory.
amharic: የደቡብ ሊባኖሷ ማንሱሪ መንደር እስራኤል በቆረጠችው ወታደራዊ የድንበር መስመር ምክንያት ለሁለት ተከፍላለች። ይህ ድንበር የሊባኖስን የተወሰነ መሬት ከሌላው የአገሪቱ ክፍል የሚለይ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎቹም በዚህ ወታደራዊ ይዞታ አቅራቢያ በመኖራቸው በየቀኑ ከፍተኛ ፍርሃትና ስጋት ውስጥ ናቸው። በተከፈለው አካባቢ የሚኖሩት እነዚህ ሰዎች እየጨመረ በመጣው የጸጥታ ችግር ምክንያት አስቸጋሪ ሕይወት እየገፉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ganda Mansuurii kan kibba Libaanositti argamu, sararri daangaa waraanaa kan 'Yellow Line' jedhamu kutaatti qooda. Daangaan kun lafa Libaanos irraa qabame kan gargar baasu yoo ta'u, jiraattonni naannoo sanaa waraana Israa'elitti dhihoo waan jiraniif sodaafi yaaddoo cimaa keessa jiru. Haala yeroo ammaa uumame kanaan, jiraattonni kun naannoo qoodame kana keessa jiraachuuf rakkachaa jiru.

title: After a deadly raid, a displaced Nigerian mother finds a lifeline in sewing
english: Safiya Musa, a Nigerian mother who lost her husband and two children during a violent bandit raid, has managed to rebuild her life by learning to sew. After fleeing her home to live in a camp for displaced people, she now earns a living making bags to support her surviving children. Despite finding stability through this new skill, she faces the difficult dilemma of whether to return to her dangerous hometown or remain in the camp to protect her hard-earned independence.
amharic: በናይጄሪያ የታጠቁ ቡድኖች በፈጸሙት ጥቃት ባለቤቷንና ሁለት ልጆቿን ያጣችው ሳፊያ ሙሳ፣ ስፌት በመማር ህይወቷን እንደገና መገንባት ችላለች። ከቀያቸው ተፈናቅለው መጠለያ ካምፕ የምትኖረው ሳፊያ፣ ቦርሳዎችን በመስፋት ለቀሩት ልጆቿ መተዳደሪያ ማግኘት ችላለች። ሆኖም አሁን ወደ ቀድሞ መንደሯ የመመለስና ያገኘችውን ነፃነት የማጣት ስጋት ውስጥ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Haati biyya Naayijeeriyaa Safiyaa Musaa jedhamtu, haleellaa hidhattootaa kanaan abbaa manaa fi ijoollee ishii lama erga dhabdee booda, hojii hodhinsaa barachuun jireenya ishii deebitee dhaabuuf carraaqxetti. Qayee ishii irraa buqqaatee buufata godaantotaa keessa kan jiraattu Safiyaan, amma baddee fi boorsaa hodhuun ijoollee ishii hafan guddifachaa jirti. Ta'us, amala kanaan of danda'uu erga eegaltee booda, gara mana ishiitti deebi'uu fi jireenya haaraa ijaarratte kana dhabuuf sodaa guddaa keessa jirti.

title: Japan turns to Canadian crude as Asia feels Hormuz supply pinch
english: Japan has begun importing crude oil from Canada via the Trans Mountain pipeline to reduce its reliance on energy supplies from the Strait of Hormuz. This shift follows regional instability caused by the war on Iran, which has significantly disrupted traditional oil routes and impacted Japan’s economic growth. Several other Asian nations are also increasing their purchases of Canadian oil to ensure a more secure and diversified supply chain.
amharic: ጃፓን ከሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ የሚገኘውን የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ጥገኝነት ለመቀነስ የካናዳ ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ወደ ሀገሯ ማስገባት ጀምራለች። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰደው በኢራን ላይ በተከፈተው ጦርነት ምክንያት በአካባቢው የተፈጠረውን የነዳጅ አቅርቦት መስተጓጎል ተከትሎ ነው። ጃፓንን ጨምሮ ሌሎች የእስያ ሀገራትም ለኢኮኖሚያቸው ደህንነት ሲባል የነዳጅ ምንጫቸውን ለመቀያየር የካናዳን ምርት እየተጠቀሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Japan hirkummaa boba'aa 'Strait of Hormuz' irraa qabdu hir'isuuf jecha, boba'aa Canada irraa gara biyya ishee galchuu jalqabdeetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame waraana Iran irratti geggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee dhiyeessiin boba'aa addunyaa waan gufatee fi. Japan dabalatee biyyoonni Eshiyaa kaan, tasgabbii dhiyeessii boba'aa isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf jecha, Canada irraa boba'aa bitachuu isaanii dabaluu irra jiru.

title: Trump met with Saudi defence minister after joint strikes on Iraq: Report
english: President Trump recently held urgent talks with the Saudi Defense Minister following joint military actions in Iraq. During the meeting, Prince Khalid bin Salman emphasized that Saudi Arabia prefers regional de-escalation rather than increased conflict with Iran. The Saudis also expressed concern that Israeli leadership is actively encouraging a wider war, which contradicts Saudi Arabia's goals for stability.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራቅ ውስጥ ከተካሄደ የጋራ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ በኋላ ከሳዑዲ መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ጋር አስቸኳይ ውይይት አድርገዋል። በስብሰባው ወቅት ልዑል ካሊድ ቢን ሳልማን ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ከኢራን ጋር ግጭት ከመፍጠር ይልቅ የክልሉን ሰላም ማቀዝቀዝ እንደምትመርጥ ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል መንግስት ጦርነቱን ለማባባስ እየገፋ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ይህ አካሄድ የሳዑዲ አረቢያን የሰላም ፍላጎት እንደሚቃረን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaant Traamp Iraaq keessatti tarkaanfii waraanaa waloo erga fudhatanii booda, ministira ittisa biyya Sa’udii waliin marii ariifachiisaa ta’e taasisaniiru. Marii kanaan, Amiir Khaalid biin Salmaan Sa’udin waliin gahiinsa waraanaa Iran waliin dabaluu mannaa, nagaa fi tasgabbii naannichaa buusuu akka barbaaddu ibsaniiru. Kana malees, mootummaan Israa’el waraana babal’isuuf yaalaa akka jiru fi kunis fedhii Sa’udii kan faallessu ta’uu himaniiru.

title: Centcom says two hours-long wave of strikes against Iran 'successfully completed'
english: The U.S. Central Command recently executed a series of targeted airstrikes against various military locations in Iran, including command centers and weapons facilities. These operations were launched as a direct retaliatory measure following an attempted missile attack on American forces. Officials confirmed that the extensive two-hour mission was completed successfully.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ በኢራን ወታደራዊ ማዕከላት፣ የጦር መሣሪያ ማከማቻዎች እና ሌሎች ቁልፍ ቦታዎች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ተከታታይ የአየር ጥቃቶችን ፈጽሟል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በአሜሪካ ኃይሎች ላይ የተፈጸመውን የሚሳይል ጥቃት ተከትሎ የተወሰዱ የመልስ እርምጃዎች ናቸው። ለሁለት ሰዓታት የዘለቀው ይህ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን በስኬት መጠናቀቁን የዕዙ መግለጫ ያመለክታል።
oromo: Ajajni giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (CENTCOM) lafa waraanaafi giddugaleessa meeshaalee waraanaa Iran keessatti argaman irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwateera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, humnoota Ameerikaa irratti haleellaa misaayilii gaggeessuuf yaalamee tureef haaloo ba'uufi. Hojiin waraanaa sa'aatii lamaaf turu kun milkiin xumuramuusaa hoggantoonni ibsaniiru.

title: More explosions reported in Iran, two children wounded by US strike in Qeshm Island
english: Multiple explosions have been reported across southern Iran, including in the city of Ahvaz. On Qeshm Island, a residential home was hit by a US military strike, leaving two children injured. Rescue teams are currently searching the wreckage to locate three other family members who remain trapped.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ኢራን በአህቫዝ ከተማን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ፍንዳታዎች ተሰምተዋል። በቃሽም ደሴት ላይ በአሜሪካ በተፈጸመ ጥቃት የመኖሪያ ቤት መመታቱን ተከትሎ ሁለት ህጻናት ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኖች በአደጋው ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ የቀሩትን ሌሎች ሶስት የቤተሰቡ አባላትን ለመፈለግ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Kibba Iraan magaalaa Ahvaaz dabalatee bakkeewwan garagaraatti dhohiinsaalee dhaga’amaniru. Qeshm Island irratti weerara waraana Ameerikaatiin mana jireenyaa tokko rukutamee ijoolleen lama miidhamaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa miseensoota maatii sanaa kanneen biroo sadii manca’aa mana sanaa jala jiran barbaaduuf sochiirra jiru.

title: Watch: Trump says Iran would be hit 'very hard'
english: Following a deadly strike on American troops in Jordan, Donald Trump warned that the United States would respond with significant force against Iran. Shortly after these comments, the U.S. military launched retaliatory operations that caused multiple explosions in various Iranian cities. This escalation marks a major development in the ongoing tensions between the two nations.
amharic: ጆርዳን ውስጥ በአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቀዋል። ይህንን ተከትሎም የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በኢራን ከተሞች ላይ የአየር ጥቃት የፈጸመ ሲሆን፣ በበርካታ አካባቢዎችም ፍንዳታዎች ተሰምተዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት ይበልጥ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Jordaanitti waraana Amerikaa irratti haleellaa raawwatame hordofee, Doonald Traamp Amerikaan tarkaanfii cimaa Iraan irratti akka fudhatu dubbataniiru. Kana boodas, waraanni Amerikaa magaalota Iraan keessatti haleellaa gaggeesseen dhukaatiin hedduun dhaga'ameera. Tarkaanfiin kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru caalaatti kan hammeesse dha.

title: Blasts rock southern Iran
english: Multiple explosions have been reported across various locations in southern Iran, including Bushehr and several islands. The United States government has confirmed that it conducted these military strikes within the region. These attacks targeted several key areas, such as Abadan and Bandar Abbas, marking a significant escalation in tensions.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ኢራን በሚገኙ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በርካታ ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙ ተዘግቧል። አሜሪካ በእነዚህ የኢራን ክልሎች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሟን በይፋ አረጋግጣለች። የቡሼር ግዛት፣ የቂሽ ደሴት እና የአባዳን ከተማን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ስትራቴጂካዊ ቦታዎች ላይ ጥቃቶቹ ተፈጽመዋል።
oromo: Kibba Iraanitti bakkeewwan garagaraatti dhukaatiiwwan hedduun gabaafamaniiru. Mootummaan Amerikaa naannolee kana keessatti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa mirkaneesseera. Haleellaan kun aanaalee akka Buusheer, qarqara galaana Abaadanii fi Bandar Abbaas dabalatee bakkeewwan gurguddoo irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture.

title: Trump cuts WHO off from Gavi vaccine alliance funding
english: The Trump administration has announced it will provide $600 million to the vaccine alliance Gavi while explicitly barring the World Health Organization from receiving any of these funds. This decision is part of an ongoing conflict between President Trump and the UN health agency, which he has previously accused of poor management during the COVID-19 pandemic. To secure this continued support, the US has mandated that Gavi implement specific reforms, including the phasing out of mercury in vaccines.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ለክትባት አቅራቢው ጋቪ (Gavi) 600 ሚሊዮን ዶላር እንደሚሰጥ አስታውቋል፤ ነገር ግን የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ከዚህ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ምንም አይነት ድርሻ እንዳያገኝ ከልክሏል። ይህ ውሳኔ በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ እና በዓለም ጤና ድርጅት መካከል ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲካሄድ በቆየው አለመግባባት የመጣ ነው። አሜሪካ ይህንን የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ለመቀጠል ጋቪ በክትባቶች ውስጥ ሜርኩሪን የመቀነስን ጨምሮ የተወሰኑ ማሻሻያዎችን እንዲያደርግ ቅድመ ሁኔታ አስቀምጣለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa dhaabbata talaallii Gaviif qarshii miiliyoona 600 akka kennu beeksisus, Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) garuu deeggarsa kana akka hin arganne dhoorkeera. Murteen kun walitti bu'insa dheeraa Prezidaant Traampii fi Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa gidduu jiru kan calaqqisiisu yoo ta'u, Traamp duraan dhaabbatichi wayita weerara vaayrasii koroonaatti hojii isaa sirnaan hin baane jedhanii komataa turan. Ameerikaan deeggarsa kana itti fufsiisuuf, Gaviin talaalliiwwan isaa keessatti meerkurii akka hir'isu fi fooyya'iinsa barbaachisaa ta'e akka taasisu gaafatteetti.

title: Russian ballistic missile strikes on Kyiv come after Zelenskyy’s warning
english: Russia recently launched ballistic missile strikes against Kyiv, resulting in fires at non-residential buildings. This attack followed a warning from President Volodymyr Zelenskyy regarding the high risk of such strikes and the urgent need for more air defense support from international partners. Although Zelenskyy recently secured an agreement with President Trump to manufacture Patriot missiles in Ukraine, the country still faces a critical shortage of interceptors to defend against these ongoing Russian assaults.
amharic: ሩሲያ በቅርቡ በኪዬቭ ላይ የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ጥቃት በመሰንዘሯ መኖሪያ ባልሆኑ ሕንጻዎች ላይ የእሳት አደጋ አስከትላለች። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘሌንስኪ ሊደርስ የሚችለውን ጥቃት አስመልክተው ካስጠነቀቁ እና ለሀገራቸው የአየር መከላከያ ድጋፍ እንደሚያስፈልግ ካሳሰቡ በኋላ ነው። ዘሌንስኪ ከፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ጋር የፓትሪዮት ሚሳኤሎችን በዩክሬን ለማምረት ስምምነት ላይ ቢደርሱም፣ ሀገሪቱ አሁንም እየደረሰባትን የሩሲያ ጥቃት ለመከላከል የሚያስችል በቂ የመከላከያ መሳሪያ እጥረት ገጥሟታል።
oromo: Raashiyaan dhiheenya kana magaalaa Kiyviifi naannawa ishee irratti xiyyaara xayyaaraa (missile) balistikii itti fayyadamuun haleellaa geggeessiteerti. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo Prezidaanti Volodimir Zeelenskiin haleellaan akkasii akka mudachuu danda'uufi gargaarsi ittisa qilleensaa biyyoota murni alaa irraa akka barbaachisu akeekkachiisanitti dha. Zeelenskiin Prezidaanti Traamp waliin walta'iinsa paatriyootii (Patriot) Kiyvi keessatti oomishuuf walii galan iyyuu, biyyattiin haleellaa Raashiyaa kana ittisuuf meeshaalee ittisaa gahaa ta'e dhabuun ishee dubbatameera.

title: Iran war live: US launches ‘powerful’ strikes after IRGC attack on Jordan
english: The United States has carried out significant retaliatory strikes against Iranian targets following a deadly ballistic missile attack on an American military base in Jordan. These operations have led to casualties, including deaths among fighters in Iraq, which has prompted strong condemnation from the Iraqi government. The situation remains highly volatile as tensions escalate between the involved nations.
amharic: በዮርዳኖስ በሚገኝ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ጣቢያ ላይ በደረሰው የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት ምክንያት አሜሪካ በአይራን ኢላማዎች ላይ ጠንካራ የአጸፋ እርምጃ ወስዳለች። ይህ ጥቃት በኢራቅ ውስጥ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ የኢራቅ መንግስት በአገሩ ላይ የተፈጸመውን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ አውግዟል። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ውጥረት አሁን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እየተባባሰ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ameerikaan buufata waraana ishee kan Yordaanos keessatti argamu irratti haleellaa misa'elaa erga raawwatamee booda, tarkaanfii cimaa Iran irratti fudhatteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun Iraaq keessatti lubbuu namootaa kan galaafate yoo ta'u, mootummaan Iraaqis haleellaa kana balaaleffateera. Dhimmi kunis biyyoota lamaan gidduutti walitti bu'iinsa uumee jiru kan hammeessu ta'a.

title: Saudi Arabia seeks international coalition against Houthis in Red Sea
english: Saudi Arabia is working to form an international coalition to protect Red Sea shipping lanes from Houthi rebel attacks. This effort comes after the Houthis initiated a maritime blockade on Saudi vessels, which has disrupted trade and driven up global oil prices. Regional leaders are currently discussing how to address these threats while expressing concern about the conflict expanding further.
amharic: ሳዑዲ አረቢያ በቀይ ባህር የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ እየደረሰ ያለውን የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ጥቃት ለመከላከል ዓለም አቀፍ ጥምረት ለመፍጠር ጥረት እያደረገች ነው። ይህ ውጥረት የተፈጠረው ሁቲዎች በሳዑዲ መርከቦች ላይ የባህር ላይ ማገጃ በመጣላቸው ሲሆን፣ ይህም የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲንር እና የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ እንዲስተጓጎል አድርጓል። የክልሉ ሀገራት ይህ ግጭት እንዳይባባስ ለመከላከል በጋራ ለመስራት እየመከሩ ይገኛል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan haleellaa finxaaleyyii Huutii irraa dooniiwwan daldalaa galaana diimaa keessa jiran ittisuuf waltajjii idil-addunyaa uumuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe erga gareen Huutii dooniiwwan Saudii irratti dhorkaa gaggeessuu isaanii booda, kunis gatiin boba'aa akka dabaluufi daldalli addunyaa akka midhaamu godheera. Biyyonni naannichaa gurguddoonis walitti bu'iinsi kun daran akka hin babal'anneef waliin hojjechuuf mari'achaa jiru.

title: Nicaragua’s Daniel Ortega aims to bar ‘traitors’ from future elections
english: Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega has proposed constitutional changes that would bar opposition members labeled as traitors from running in future elections. The amendment also aims to lengthen the presidential term from six years to seven and allows for that term to be renewed indefinitely. Critics argue these measures are designed to consolidate the Ortega family's control over the country and stifle democratic participation.
amharic: የኒካራጓው ፕሬዚዳንት ዳንኤል ኦርቴጋ በአገሪቱ ምርጫ ላይ ተቃዋሚዎች እንዳይሳተፉ የሚከለክል ሕገ መንግሥታዊ ማሻሻያ አቅርበዋል። ይህ ረቂቅ የፕሬዚዳንትነት ዘመንን ከስድስት ወደ ሰባት ዓመታት ከማራዘሙም በላይ ዘመኑን ደጋግሞ ለማደስ የሚያስችል ዕድል ይከፍታል። ተቺዎች እንደሚሉት ይህ እርምጃ የኦርቴጋ ቤተሰብ በስልጣን ላይ ያላቸውን ቆይታ ለማራዘም እና ዲሞክራሲን ለማፈን የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin biyya Nikaraaguwaa Daaniyel Ortee gaa, namoota mormitoota ta'an kan 'gantoota' jedhaman filannoo irratti akka hirmaatan dhorkuuf yaada fooyya'insa heera mootummaa dhiyeessaniiru. Fooyya'insi kun yeroo tajaajila pireezidaantummaa waggaa ja'arraa gara torbaatti kan dheeressuufi yeroo kanas irra deddeebi'anii akka itti fufan kan heyyamuudha. Warri morman akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun maatii Ortee gaa aangoorra turuufi mirga dimookiraasii biyyattii cunqursuuf kan kaayyeffatedha.

title: Report: US conducting strikes in Iran
english: The United States military has reportedly launched airstrikes against targets in Iran. This action follows a statement from President Donald Trump, who promised a severe response to a previous attack on American forces stationed in Jordan. These strikes mark a significant escalation in tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል በኢራን ኢላማዎች ላይ የአየር ጥቃት መፈጸሙ ተዘግቧል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በዮርዳኖስ ለሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ጥቃት ከተሰነዘረ በኋላ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጡ ቃል ከገቡ በኋላ ነው። ይህ ሁኔታ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa gara Iranitti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwachuu gabaafameera.
